notes.title: New Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
With great satisfaction we inform the new update 1.1.0 with the changes below:
- Fixed a bug that prevented some texts from being displayed correctly when changing languages.
- Addition of Easy Difficulty, as desired by the community.
(to access the new option, select settings menu from the main game screen)

We hope you enjoy the game!

Djamp Games
